targets.name: The Gateposts
targets.brief: Two matching posts either side of a gap, capped in yellow.

targets.name: Founder's Hut
targets.brief: A four-wall hut with a doorway, one window, and a red roof that steps in twice.

targets.name: Signal Tower
targets.brief: A stepped tower that narrows as it rises, with a lamp at the top.

targets.name: Stone Span
targets.brief: Two grey piers stepped in white, carrying a deck with brown railings and a lamp at each end.

targets.name: Halt & Canopy
targets.brief: A platform under a canopy on four columns, with a bench and a lamp.

targets.name: The Village Well
targets.brief: A round grey well with four brown posts and a small red roof over it.

targets.name: Garden Gate
targets.brief: A white gateway with a green hedge on each side and a yellow lamp on top.

targets.name: Watchtower
targets.brief: A round grey tower six bricks high, with a wider dark top and a lamp.

targets.name: Market Row
targets.brief: Three stalls side by side with red, yellow and blue awnings.

targets.name: Garden Pavilion
targets.brief: A white chhatri standing on a two-step sandstone plinth with a lamp at each corner.

targets.name: Glass Office
targets.brief: A dark podium under a blue glass tower, with rooftop plant and a mast.

targets.name: Level Crossing
targets.brief: A road crossing a railway, with a signal on one side and a lamp on the other.

targets.name: Temple Shrine
targets.brief: A granite spire on a stepped plinth, with a pillared hall in front of it.

targets.name: Fountain Court
targets.brief: A fountain in the middle, four green beds on the diagonals, a bench on each side.

targets.name: Clock Tower
targets.brief: A tall tan tower banded in white, with a clock near the top and a lamp above it.
